name: Card Data 14
definition: Non-protected sensitive data associated with the card or payment token performing the transaction.

PAN.name: PAN
PAN.definition: Primary Account Number (PAN) of the card or a surrogate of the PAN such as a payment token.|ISO 8583 bit 2

CardSequenceNumber.name: Card Sequence Number
CardSequenceNumber.definition: Distinguishes between instances of the same payment card.|ISO 8583 bit 23

PaymentAccountReference.name: Payment Account Reference
PaymentAccountReference.definition: Unique non-financial reference assigned to a given PAN. May be used to link the transaction activity to that PAN.||ISO 8583:87 bit 56 (TLV tag 01/dataset 71)|ISO 8583:93 bit 112 (TLV tag 01/dataset 71)|ISO 8583:2003 bit 51 (TLV tag 01/dataset 71)
